title: Dell security advisory (AV26-1027)
description: As of October 6, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Dell Container Storage Modules (CSM)
	Prior to 1.18.0

Dell OpenManage Integration with Microsoft Windows Admin Center (OMIMSWAC)
	Prior to 3.7.0

Dell Policy Manager for Secure Connect Gateway - Appliance
	Prior to 5.36.00.16
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
